uncited: Multi Field Visualization is a diagnostic and preview tool for visualizing multiple scalar, vector, and color fields within a simulation environment.
The node accepts an optional object stream input (First Input) to specify which simulation objects are modified.
If unconnected, it can be used with an Apply Data node or as input to another data node.
Scalar fields are treated as monochromatic for color fields.
If a color ramp has one volume bound, the value looks up the color.
*   **Emission Color Physical Blackbody:** Maps Emission Color Field values using the blackbody radiation spectrum.
The node defines local variables for each channel/parameter on the Data Options page, evaluating to the previous value stored in attached data.
Fog density is per unit and independent of resolution.
Small boxes become transparent, especially without HDR rendering.
